layout: `indices` and `frozen_indices` are SORTED here so a port using a different traversal order can compare them as sets. free_mask is (H,W) as 0/1.
compare: exact. These are integer indices and integer bboxes; there is no tolerance to spend. `render` is float, relative 1e-13 -- it truncates each emitter at 4 sigma, so a port must truncate at the same radius or it will disagree in the 5th digit at the patch rim, not the 15th.
